metadata.description:
P.S.A. Please DO NOT buy any DVD set online from shady websites that claim to have the complete series. They are just using these files that I have provided here and putting them on burned discs. You can do this yourself FOR FREE! That's why I uploaded this archive, so the fans can have free access to a lost show. NEVER give those scammers your money for any so-called "complete" set.

TheChipratsIndividual presents all 102 episodes from the 1983 Alvin & The Chipmunks cartoon, the 7 television specials, "The Chipmunk Adventure" feature film, and 2 monster crossover home releases, "Chipmunks Meet Frankenstein" and "Chipmunks Meet The Wolfman."

Also includes "Cartoon All-Stars to the Rescue," which features the Chipmunk trio; "Little Alvin and the Mini Munks," a puppet movie said to be in the same canon as the 1983 cartoon; and "Alvin Goes Back to School," a live-action special made during the cartoon's original run. All of these included extra videos are all somewhat related to the 1983 cartoon but may not be technically part of the complete series. Additionally, some retro commercials for The Chipmunks have been included but are by no means a complete collection of ads. A tiny bit of extras were added, too, like an alternate episode scene and music videos.

The quality of these video files varies from DVD rips to barely watchable VHS rips, but a vast majority are of good quality. A small handful of episodes are slightly incomplete, where the first few minutes of the episodes are cutoff . These imperfections are unfortunate but to be expected due to the rarity of some of these episodes, many having been lost media for years. Since no official DVD/streaming release of the cartoon has been released, this archive is the best collection of the show online right now, so please excuse any faults it may have.

The long lost episode "The Princess and the Pig" has been found and is included in this archive (uploaded on YouTube by @TheChipmunkGuy and @metalmusic1401). I made an unofficial recreation of the episode in English that is also included, too, but it is obsolete now that the real episode was discovered.
